title: Tabulation block base
statement: Let $\kappa$ be a finite type, let $m,w,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $F$ assign a Boolean list to each pair consisting of an element of $\kappa$ and a Boolean list, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. If $T$ denotes the total width reserved for one program instruction, the base index of instruction $i\in\mathbb{N}$ is $n+2+|z|+T(i+1)$.
